notes.title: Trading Cards are HERE! (For Real This Time)
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! I'm happy to announce that we got everything sorted out and trading cards have just been approved for Angry Video Game Nerd Adventures. Thanks for your patience while we got this sorted out! In case you're unfamiliar as to how they work here's a brief description.

Q: How do I get trading cards?
A: By playing AVGNA you’ll earn a random collection of up to half the full set of trading cards. To acquire the other half you need to trade or buy them from other players.

Q: OK I have them all, what now?
A: Great! Now that you've collected them all you can craft the set into a badge, which you can display on your Steam profile!

Q: Cool, anything else?
A: Yep! Continue collecting cards and crafting sets to unlock more badges, Steam EXP, emoticons for chat and even profile backgrounds!

Thanks to everyone for picking up the game! Now start collecting!

notes.title: Patch 1.7 Notes (Now Live)
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Patch 1.7 has just been pushed live. To ensure you're playing the most current version of Angry Video Game Nerd Adventures, please close the game and reboot steam.

[u]Patch 1.7 Notes[/u]
[LIST]
[*]Keyboard mapping has been added and can be found in the options menu.
[*]Users can now disable gamepad detection. To do this type “/gamepadoff” in the game’s Launch Options in Steam
[*]Fixed a bug where the Window would periodically reset it’s position to the middle of the screen if the user had moved it
[*]You can no longer get stuck in the re-appearing blocks in Boo! Haunted House
[*]Time now maxes out at 999 minutes in the options menu
[*]Beer, Deaths and 1ups collected now max out at 9999 in the options menu
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing the game from returning to the main menu after completing the game
[/list]
For a list of other things that we're working on please visit our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/237740/discussions/0/846965056827666023/]Upcoming Features Thread[/url]. If you'd like to view the previous patch notes, they can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/237740/discussions/0/792923683654130168/]here[/url]. Thanks for picking up the game!

notes.title: Patch 1.5 Patch Notes [Now Live]
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Patch 1.5 has just been pushed live. To ensure you're playing the most current version of Angry Video Game Nerd Adventures, please close the game and reboot steam.

[u]Patch 1.5 Notes[/u]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed a bug that would sometimes allow bullets to pass through "Bob the Robot" enemies.
[*]Fixed a bug in Dungeons and Dickholes that would cause players to get stuck in the bridge if a disappearing block appeared on top of them.
[*][u]Added Multiple Video modes to the Options menu[/u]
[list]
[*][b]Full[/b] - Default recommended mode that displays the game at full screen.
[*][b]Compatibility Mode[/b] - Displays at full screen, but with a fix for users that experience an issue where the screen is displayed in a small window in the corner of the screen.
[*][b]Window[/b] - Displays the game in a 960x540 window.
[*][b]Window (Medium)[/b] - Displays the game in a 640x360 window.
[*][b]Window (Small)[/b] - Displays the game in a 320x180 window
[/list]
[*]Pressing the Esc key when in Full Mode will automatically switch the game to Window Mode and can be done at any time.
[/LIST]
For a list of other things that we're working on please visit our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/237740/discussions/0/846965056827666023/]Upcoming Features Thread[/url]. If you'd like to view the previous patch notes, they can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/237740/discussions/]here[/url]. Thanks for picking up the game!

notes.title: Now Available - Angry Video Game Nerd Adventures
notes.content:
Angry Video Game Nerd Adventures is Now Available on Steam

Influenced by retro classics Mega Man and Castlevania, Angry Video Game Nerd Adventures features the AVGN and friends as they blast their way through 10 levels of fun, fast paced 2D action based on the AVGN's adventures in his online series. With multiple playable characters, power ups, cameos galore, tons of secrets and more we're making a game that all fans of video games will enjoy.
